GTO Strategy & Strategic Planning: Lead development of multi-year GTO strategy, transformation roadmaps, investment priorities, and strategic planning processes. Translate enterprise objectives into executable plans across Technology and Operations, ensuring strategic intent is reflected in investment and delivery decisions before resources are committed.
AI-Native Operating Model Transformation: Design and evolve future-state operating models that combine AI, automation, workforce transformation, and technology productivity to sustainably improve capacity, customer outcomes, and efficiency across Technology and Operations — including delivery models, product operating models, workforce structures, and technology ways of working.

In this role, you will support execution of GTO's strategy, transformation, AI enablement, workforce modernization, value realization, and governance agenda. You will serve as a key coordination point across 14 countries, maintaining visibility across portfolio priorities and supporting timely execution, while also enabling Tech and Operations teams — who are increasingly building and owning AI models through low-code/no-code and vendor solutions — to understand and fulfill their first-line Model Risk Management obligations. Operational Analytics & Diagnostics: Conduct deep-dive, multi-year performance analysis across GTO segments and functions to identify root causes of performance shifts and quantify improvement opportunities — spanning operational metrics (e.g., volume, containment, service level, workforce trends), technology delivery metrics, and financial/benefit data, depending on the initiative. Reconcile findings across multiple data sources, flagging discrepancies and data-quality issues rather than presenting unverified figures. Build reusable analytical frameworks (e.g., target-setting waterfalls, seasonality-adjusted projections, business-case models) that leadership can rely on for decision-making across current and future transformation priorities — contact centre performance is one current application of this capability, not its definition.
Business Case Development & Value Realization: Build quantified business cases, validate assumptions, reconcile benefits, support investment prioritization, and track transformation outcomes. Ensure benefit claims remain defensible against source data as initiatives move from proposal through delivery.
Transformation Planning & Execution: Support delivery of GTO transformation initiatives through roadmap development, milestone tracking, dependency management, and executive reporting.
Executive Decision Support & Strategic Communications: Produce competitive benchmarking, landscape analysis, and strategic briefings to support AVP and Director decision-making. Synthesize complex information — regulatory developments, market signals, internal performance data — into clear, executive-ready formats, including anticipated-question briefs ahead of ELT and Board/Technology Committee sessions, Board and investor-facing content, and strategic storyline development. Operating Model & Workforce Analysis: Analyze workforce trends, process changes, productivity opportunities, and future-state operating models to support AI-enabled transformation initiatives.
Responsible AI Governance: Lead evidence coordination and governance pipeline management for AI initiative reviews. Work credibly and independently with Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Privacy partners — ensuring clearance without stalling delivery. Own the end-to-end governance intake pipeline, flag blockers early, and maintain accurate documentation aligned to enterprise standards including OSFI E-23 and privacy frameworks.
Model Risk Management Enablement: As Tech and Operations teams increasingly own AI models built through low-code/no-code tools and vendor solutions, provide guidance and subject matter expertise to model owners on their first-line MRM obligations. Support teams in preparing and submitting required documentation — model cards, risk tiering assessments, methodology documentation, and monitoring plans — and assist them in maintaining ongoing obligations including review cycles, change notifications, and performance reporting. Accountability for model risk remains with the designated model owner in Tech or Operations.
Global Coordination: Maintain the operational rhythm across 14 countries — intake tracking, reporting cadence, escalation management, and cross-country knowledge sharing. Ensure the AVP and Director have timely, accurate visibility across portfolio priorities and emerging issues.

Establish and share these patterns across the team, and maintain a living knowledge base of methodology, findings, and reusable analysis patterns to accelerate future work.

Experience supporting enterprise strategy, operating model design, transformation programs, or value realization initiatives.

Ability to communicate complex analysis and MRM obligations clearly and accessibly to non-specialist stakeholders across Tech and Operations teams.
Strong organizational and coordination skills; comfortable managing multiple concurrent workstreams across global teams.
Strong analytical and written communication skills; able to synthesize complex information for senior audiences.

In 2021, the OECD/G20 Inclusive Framework on Base Erosion and Profit Shifting issued the Pillar Two framework, which is intended to ensure that large multinational enterprises, such as Manulife, pay a minimum effective tax rate of 15% in each jurisdiction in which they operate.
